title:
PROPORTION,
(PROPORTION GRAPHS)
objective: LO: I can interpret and draw graphs showing direct and inverse proportion.

content.text: A direct proportion graph is a straight line through the origin. An inverse proportion graph is a curve (hyperbola) that never touches the axes.
Key features: Direct: y = kx (linear, through origin). Inverse: y = k/x (curve, asymptotes at axes).

examples.expr: Gradient of direct proportion line = k
Any straight line shows direct proportion
Inverse proportion graphs are straight lines

key_idea.title: Key idea
key_idea.text: Direct proportion: straight line through origin (gradient = k). Inverse proportion: reciprocal curve.
key_idea.equation: Direct: y = kx | Inverse: y = &frac{k}{x}
key_idea.caption: Recognise the shape to identify the type

modelled_examples.label: Example 1 – direct proportion graph
modelled_examples.question: The graph of y against x passes through (0, 0) and (4, 12). Is this direct proportion? Find k.
steps: Passes through origin: yes, could be direct proportion
modelled_examples.explanation: A straight line through the origin confirms direct proportion.

modelled_examples.label: Example 2 – reading values from a graph
modelled_examples.question: A direct proportion graph passes through (5, 20). Find y when x = 8.
modelled_examples.explanation: Use any point on the line to find k.

modelled_examples.label: Example 3 – identifying inverse proportion
modelled_examples.question: A graph curves downward, approaching but never touching the x-axis. The point (2, 6) is on it. Find the equation.
steps: Shape suggests inverse proportion: y = k/x
modelled_examples.explanation: A curve with axes as asymptotes suggests inverse proportion.

modelled_examples.label: Example 4 – comparing graph types
modelled_examples.question: Graph A is a line through origin. Graph B is a curve approaching axes. Which shows direct proportion?
steps: Graph A is the direct proportion graph
modelled_examples.answer: Graph A = direct, Graph B = inverse
modelled_examples.explanation: The shape tells you the type of proportion.
